# telnyx_networks (Data Source)

Lists networks, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_network`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String) The network name to filter on.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `name` (String) A user specified name for the network.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
